from_node.description: Heidegger shifts from the formal identity principle toward a question of belonging-together of human being and Being.

to_node.description: This belonging-together is not thereby a replacement criterion for numerical identity or persistence of ordinary entities.

bridge.statement: Belonging can relate distinct relata; therefore success of the ontological belonging analysis does not entail x=y or persistence criteria.

id4.termination_condition: not applicable as ordinary numerical identity
id4.revision_trigger: Textual evidence that Heidegger intends Zusammengehörigkeit as ordinary x=y or persistence criterion.

audit_semantics.relation_rationale: The frozen registry has no justified generic relation for Heideggerian belonging-together; RT00 prevents a false promotion to reference or numerical identity.
review_notes: RT17 was removed because belonging-together is not a sign-reference or denotation relation.

rivals.description: Treat belonging-together as a criterion of numerical identity or persistence.
rivals.bridge: Would require token/type and synchronic/diachronic identity criteria.
rivals.discriminator: Test ordinary-entity identity cases; the Heideggerian explanandum switch should not supply their criterion.

rivals.description: Treat belonging-together as disclosure or access rather than identity.
rivals.bridge: Requires an account of what is disclosed to whom and under what conditions.
rivals.discriminator: Separate disclosure vocabulary from a claim about identity.
